messages:
announce-bot: Quick update: KUL1 (apac-kul1) will run a limited preview of the Helios-H2400 Dedicated compact pools (8x 48GB) starting Mon 2026-09-14 10:00 MYT. Pilot + policy notes below. :sparkles:
mina: (product) This is an invite-only preview aimed at customers with medium-memory, high-concurrency workloads. Seats limited; apply via Capacity Request Form.
raj: (infra) Hardware note: Helios-H2400 has a tiled mesh with ultra-fast host I/O. We've added a memory-striping allocator and micro-batching primer for better small-batch throughput. Benchmarks: ~9-12% p99 token latency reduction on chat workloads.
cleo: (ops) Scheduling: preview pools will be labeled "helios-preview" and run in hybrid mode. We'll enable a 48h reserved-priority window at open to stabilize committed tenants. After that we'll slowly ramp shared traffic.
ops: Policy tweaks (preview-only): minimum reservation for Helios pockets in KUL1 = 2 days. Also introducing a new "latency-tier" tag on reservations: low-latency / cost-efficient. Tagging helps automatic routing to warm vs cold micro-pools.
billing-bot: Billing (internal): Helios reserved = $A/hr committed; shared-burst = $B/hr on-demand. Reservations billed daily pro-rata. Latency-tier tagged jobs consume warm-pool credits first. Full numbers in runbook.
mina: rollout plan: 10:00 MYT soft-open, 48h priority window, monitor for 14 days, then decide expansion.
raj: infra config snippet (ops reference):
```
pool: apac-kul1-helios-h2400-preview
node_type: helios-h2400
mode: hybrid
priority_window_secs: 172800  # 48h
fairshare_reserved: 230
fairshare_shared: 70
latency_tier_tagging: enabled
alert_group: capacity.helios.spill
```
cleo: ops actions: add alert capacity.helios.spill to APAC oncall for preview. If spill > 10% sustained for 5m, escalate. Also enable latency-tier enforcement rules at open.
raj: infra actions: push memory-striping and micro-batching primer to staging tonight; prod push 03:00 MYT pre-open.
sales-bot: Sales: offering a 21-day pilot addendum for invited customers. Priority access for strategic accounts. Use Capacity Request Form.
announce-bot: Docs & runbook (internal): https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/helios-h2400-kul1-preview - internal only. Please report regressions in #eng-runtime and tag @raj/@cleo. :eyes:
